person_note: The quote set repeatedly exposes close third-person base narration centered on Krissy, Margot, and Billy, including access to their private feelings, realizations, and counterfactual thoughts. First- and second-person forms in the quotes belong to dialogue, embedded gossip formulas, or explicitly marked unspoken thought. The sustained opening excerpt independently shows both principal timelines in third person, while the whole-book structural source states that the focal character changes to Krissy, Margot, and finally Billy without changing narratorial person. Thus the shifting viewpoints are focalization within THIRD, not ALTERNATING person. The opening source alone has limited scope, but the whole-book analysis and numerous interior quote passages resolve that limitation; no credible contrary evidence was found.
